Something big just happened in the AI world.

OpenAI reportedly lost over 1.5 million subscribers in less than 48 hours, and the internet is asking one question — why are users leaving ChatGPT?

The situation started after Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, agreed to a deal with the United States Department of Defense to allow AI models on a classified government network.

But here’s the twist — Anthropic, the company behind Claude AI, reportedly rejected the same deal.

Soon after the news spread, many users started canceling their subscriptions and moving away from ChatGPT.

In this video we explain:
 • What actually happened
 • Why people are worried about AI and government use
 • Why some users are switching to Claude
 • And how to export your ChatGPT data before deleting your account

Before leaving ChatGPT, make sure you export your chat history so you don’t lose your prompts, memories, and projects.

What do you think?

Are you staying with ChatGPT or switching to Claude?
